subtests.name: getBoxQuads({box: "margin"}) returns the requested CSS box
getBoxQuads({box: "border"}) returns the requested CSS box
getBoxQuads({box: "padding"}) returns the requested CSS box
getBoxQuads({box: "content"}) returns the requested CSS box
getBoxQuads() defaults to the border box
getBoxQuads({relativeTo}) uses the relative element border-box origin
getBoxQuads() combines box and relativeTo options
getBoxQuads() point order is physical for bidi and writing-mode
